description: Is the genistein induction of the bll6421-bll6428 operon dependent on the NodW/NwsA two-component systems?
code:
import requests,re,numpy as np,pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
open("/tmp/a.gz","wb").write(requests.get("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE8nnn/GSE8580/matrix/GSE8580_series_matrix.txt.gz",timeout=60).content)
df=pd.read_csv("/tmp/a.gz",compression="gzip",sep="\t",comment="!",low_memory=False).set_index("ID_REF")
G={"WT_gen":["GSM212687","GSM212688","GSM212689"],"WT_ctl":["GSM212690","GSM212691","GSM212692"],
   "nodW_gen":["GSM212768","GSM212769","GSM212770"],"d901_gen":["GSM212771","GSM212772","GSM212773"]}
print(df.shape, df.iloc[:3,:4].round(3).to_string())
OP=[f"bll{n}" for n in range(6421,6429)]
num=df.index.to_series().str.extract(r"^bl[lr](\d+)")[0]
df2=df[num.notna()].copy(); df2["ord"]=num.dropna().astype(int).values; df2=df2.sort_values("ord")
def contrast(a,b,label):
    fc=df2[G[a]].mean(axis=1)-df2[G[b]].mean(axis=1)
    fc=fc.dropna(); op=fc.reindex(OP).dropna(); obs=op.mean(); k=len(op)
    v=fc.values; W=np.array([v[i:i+k].mean() for i in range(len(v)-k+1)])
    emp=(np.sum(W>=obs)+1)/(len(W)+1)
    nod=[g for g in ["bll2049","bll2050","bll2051","bll2052","blr2027"] if g in fc.index]
    print("%-22s operon mean log2FC %+.3f (n=%d)  empirical P=%.4f  pct=%.1f | bll6422 %+.3f | nod %s"%(
        label,obs,k,emp,stats.percentileofscore(W,obs),fc.get("bll6422",np.nan),
        {g:round(fc[g],1) for g in nod}))
    return op,obs,emp
r1=contrast("WT_gen","WT_ctl","WT +genistein")
r2=contrast("nodW_gen","WT_ctl","nodW mutant +gen")
r3=contrast("d901_gen","WT_ctl","nodW nwsA d901 +gen")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,4.4))
labs=["WT\n+genistein","nodW mutant 613\n+genistein","nodW nwsA $\\Delta$901\n+genistein"]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.1
for i,g in enumerate(OP):
    vals=[r[0].get(g,np.nan) for r in (r1,r2,r3)]
    ax.bar(x+(i-3.5)*w,vals,width=w,color="#c1442e" if g=="bll6422" else "#6f9ac8",
           label=g if i in (0,1) else None)
    for xx,v in zip(x+(i-3.5)*w,vals):
        if g=="bll6422" and np.isfinite(v): ax.text(xx,v+0.04,"bll6422",rotation=90,fontsize=6.5,ha="center",color="#c1442e")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9); ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6)
ax.set_ylabel("log2 fold change vs uninduced wild type")
ax.set_title("bll6421-bll6428 induction by genistein is retained in nod two-component mutants (GSE8580)",fontsize=10.5)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
